<question>
Can the owner of a mobile home park in Florida raise my lot rent as much as he likes?
</question>

<answer>
Florida has no statewide cap on how much a mobile home park owner can raise lot rent, and Florida law generally prevents local governments from imposing rent control on these lots. The owner must give written notice of the increase at least 90 days before it takes effect. Rent increases are also limited by the rental agreement, so an increase generally cannot take effect during a lease term unless the lease permits it.
</answer>
